workspace_base_requirement: The same pre-audit commit is used for all conditions; no DelayedFeedback audit declaration, target-drift manifest, or case-specific memory exists in the base.

common_isolation.cross_run_state: forbidden except the pinned read-only toolchain and dependency cache
common_isolation.source_packet_mount: one hash-verified PDF copied read-only into the run directory
common_isolation.host_filesystem_visibility: forbidden outside the prepared run directory and pinned read-only toolchain/dependency mounts
common_isolation.network_policy: the evaluated agent has no general network access; only the model adapter may reach its configured provider
common_isolation.process_policy: fresh adapter process and context per run with enforced process-tree timeout

additional_writable_outputs: one run-local source-to-target blueprint authored during the run
run-local ABRL contract, blueprint, retrieval, failure, and promotion records
forbidden_resources: case-specific artifacts created after the workspace base commit
other runs' prompts, workspaces, or outputs

required_preflight: content-addressed file manifest for every condition view
semantic case/source identifiers absent from the rendered agent prompt and workspace
evaluation, .git, host paths, sibling runs, and general network inaccessible
one-case three-condition infrastructure smoke run excluded from results
